jobs.title: Platform Growth Lead
jobs.description:
About Us:

At Parafin, we’re on a mission to grow small businesses.

Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, but traditional banks often don’t have their backs. We build tech that makes it simple for small businesses to access the financial tools they need through the platforms they already sell on. 

We partner with companies like DoorDash, Amazon, Worldpay, and Mindbody to offer fast and flexible funding, spend management, and savings tools  to their small business users via a simple integration. Parafin takes on all the complexity of capital markets, underwriting, servicing, compliance, and customer service for our partners.

We’re a tight-knit team of innovators hailing from Stripe, Square, Plaid, Coinbase, Robinhood, CERN, and more — all united by a passion for building tools that help small businesses succeed. Parafin is backed by prominent venture capitalists including GIC, Notable Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Ribbit Capital, and Thrive Capital. Parafin is a Series C company, and we have raised more than $194M in equity and $340M in debt facilities.

Join us in creating a future where every small business has the financial tools they need.



About the Position

We are looking for a Platform Growth Lead to launch and grow our expanding roster of platform partners. This is an existing business account management role spanning a wide variety of B2B verticals. This role will also work cross-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing teams to drive outcomes for your accounts.

You will directly contribute to the growth of the small businesses our platform partners serve and will manage some of Parafin's most strategic accounts. If you enjoy working on products that help small businesses and thrive on creating win-win-win solutions for partners/merchants / Parafin, come join us!



What You’ll Be Doing:

 - Lead the post-sale onboarding, engagement, retention, and growth of strategic platform customers

 - Drive expansion within accounts in the form of increasing loan origination and product expansion – identify new strategic opportunities to improve marketing, drive new product adoption and integration, and unlock incremental user segments to help partners grow.

 - Drive overall account health, including capital origination performance, product adoption, and customer satisfaction.

 - Closely monitor KPIs for your set of accounts and conduct preliminary diagnosis on issues that may impact growth and account health. You will coordinate with internal teams and partners to help growth stay on track.

 - Support or lead quarterly business reviews and influence partners to prioritize and pursue key growth, GTM, and new product initiatives.

 - Share customer feedback and insights with Product, Engineering, Support, and Platform Partnerships to empower and inform improvements to the Parafin partner experience
   
   

What We’re Searching For:

 - At least 5 years of experience in a customer success or partnerships role, preferably focused on mid-market or enterprise segments

 - Experience in a client-facing role managing multi-threaded relationships for a technical product, and demonstrated ability to build deep and influential relationships with partners up to the director level.

 - Track record of leading technical conversations and influencing internal and external teams to take action based on business and partner impact.

 - Proven track record of achieving revenue-based targets and goals, and driving account expansion

 - Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, strong presence with partners

 - Relentlessly navigate data and people to find answers

 - Driven to help grow small businesses
   
   

We Prefer If You Have:

 - Familiarity with working on API-driven and other technical products

 - Experience building business cases to drive strategic decision-making by your accounts

 - Prior exposure to working directly with executive/C-suite stakeholders.

 - Experience working with cross-functional teams to solve account issues and drive partner experience improvements

 - Some experience with product marketing and/or go-to-market strategy
   
   

What We Offer

 - Salary Range: $170 - 240K (OTE)

 - Equity grant

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance

 - Work from home flexibility

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Commuter benefits

 - Free lunches

 - Paid parental leave

 - 401(k)

 - Employee assistance program
   
   

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact us.

Parafin takes on all the complexity of capital markets, underwriting, servicing, compliance, and customer service for our partners.

We’re a tight-knit team of innovators hailing from Stripe, Square, Plaid, Coinbase, Robinhood, CERN, and more — all united by a passion for building tools that help small businesses succeed. Parafin is backed by prominent venture capitalists including GIC, Notable Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Ribbit Capital, and Thrive Capital. Parafin is a Series C company, and we have raised more than $194M in equity and $340M in debt facilities.

Join us in creating a future where every small business has the financial tools they need.



About the Position

We're looking for our founding Brand Designer to own Parafin's visual identity across every surface: website, social media, blog, paid ads, video, events, and more. You'll be the creative force behind how Parafin looks and feels in the world.

This role is about more than making things look good. You'll bring strategic thinking to brand consistency, help us scale our visual system, and collaborate across teams to produce high-quality work that reflects who we are and the mission we're on. If you love building brands from the inside out and want your work to support small businesses, you'll feel right at home here.

This role sits on the design team and partners closely with marketing to bring the brand to life.



What You’ll Be Doing:

 - Own and evolve Parafin's visual identity, maintaining the brand system and building out templates and components. Maintain and scale a brand asset library and style guide so the whole company can stay on-brand.

 - Concept and execute marketing campaigns across web, social, paid ads, email, blog, and video, from initial idea to final delivery.

 - Design, build, and maintain website assets and pages, partnering with marketing and engineering to keep our web presence polished, modern, and up to date.

 - Art-direct and produce video and motion content for social, ads, and web: hands-on or through vendors.

 - Collaborate with the product design team to accurately represent and market our product, highlighting key features, maintaining visual consistency, and ensuring product visuals reflect the real experience we deliver.

 - Create event and office materials such as posters, signage, swag, and internal communications.

 - Proactively identify opportunities to improve how Parafin shows up in the market, finding gaps in the brand system and proposing how to fill them before being asked.
   
   

What we’re looking for:

 - 6+ years of visual/brand design experience

 - A versatile brand and graphic designer with a strong portfolio spanning digital and print. Comfortable working across mediums: web, social, print, environmental, and motion.

 - Experience owning a visual identity end-to-end, from brand strategy and ideation to execution and rollout.

 - Experience leading or contributing to a rebrand or brand refresh.

 - Strong proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), and AI tools in your design workflow.

 - Excellent typography, layout, and composition skills with a sharp eye for detail.

 - Familiarity with web design principles and asset handoff for digital production.

 - Autonomous enough to take a brief and run with it, and strong enough as a communicator to present and defend creative decisions to stakeholders.
   
   

We Prefer If You Have:

 - Experience working on brand design in fintech, B2B SaaS, or financial services.

 - Motion design or animation skills (After Effects, Lottie, etc.).

 - Photography or art direction experience.
   
   

What We Offer

 - Salary Range: $180 - $220k

 - Equity grant

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Work from home flexibility on Mondays and Fridays

 - Commuter benefits

 - Free lunches

 - Paid parental leave

 - 401(k)

 - Employee assistance program
   
   
   
   

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please contact us.

Are you an innovative compliance manager with a passion for building and managing compliance programs at a rapidly scaling company? If so, come join us!



What You’ll Be Doing:

 - Advising business teams on compliance matters related to information security, data sharing, and vendor oversight

 - Dynamic multi-tasker who can juggle multiple priorities and complexities with ease

 - Awesome communication skills, both written and verbal



We Prefer If You Have:

 - Familiarity with BSA/AML/OFAC/KYC, UDAP, Fair Lending/ECOA, or NACHA compliance

 - Experience working with bank partners and/or banking regulators

 - Background at a FinTech supporting B2B financial services products

Join us in creating a future where every small business has the financial tools they need.



About the Position

We’re looking for a Head of Marketing to join our leadership team and build the next chapter of Parafin’s marketing strategy. This role will own everything from brand to narrative to demand generation as we scale from fintech disruptor to category leader. This is a senior-level marketing hire who wants to both develop and execute on the marketing strategy and is willing to roll up their sleeves. You’ll report to the CRO and partner closely with Founders, Product, and GTM teams. You’ll define the brand ethos that resonates with platform leaders, build the demand engine that unlocks predictable growth, and position Parafin as the default choice for small business embedded financial services.



What You’ll Be Doing:

 - Building a comprehensive Marketing strategy – develop and execute the company’s overall marketing vision and strategy. Align marketing initiatives with business goals, product strategy, and revenue objectives.

 - Brand Management – Define and strengthen the company’s brand, positioning, and messaging frameworks that make “Parafin-powered” synonymous with modern embedded finance that serves small businesses.

 - Build a full-funnel engine – Lead customer acquisition, lead generation, and revenue-driving marketing campaigns that generate and accelerate $XXXM+ pipeline.

 - Communication & PR – Shape category-defining thought leadership and develop key messages that will build favorable awareness for Parafin amongst our platforms, small businesses, and for recruiting.

 - Launch products that win markets – Partner with Product & GTM to create product-marketing playbooks, pricing narratives, and enablement materials for new offerings.

 - Lead & scale a high-impact team – Recruit, mentor, and inspire a multidisciplinary marketing org

 - Own insights & analytics – Define KPIs, implement tooling, and turn data into action that levels up acquisition, engagement, and customer expansion.
   
   

What We’re Searching For:

 - 10+ years in B2B marketing with at least 4 years leading teams in fintech, SaaS, or payments.

 - Experience building and defining fintech brands to a B2B audience.

 - Demonstrated success generating 8-figure pipeline at Series B+ or public-company scale.

 - Deep command of growth and demand-gen channels (case studies, blog posts, ABM, events, partner marketing) and modern MarTech stacks.

 - Strategic mindset with hands-on bias: you can set vision, roll up sleeves, and iterate quickly.

 - Proven product-marketing chops—able to translate complex financial technology into clear, compelling value propositions.

 - Exceptional storytelling, written, and verbal communication skills; comfortable in front of C-suite execs, journalists, and conference stages.
   
   

We Prefer If You Have:

 - Experience marketing to two-sided platforms or marketplaces.

 - Familiarity with capital markets, underwriting, or credit products.
   
   

What We Offer

 - Salary Range: $250 - $320k

 - Equity grant

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance

 - Unlimited PTO & work-from-home flexibility

 - Commuter benefits

 - Free lunches

 - Paid parental leave

 - 401(k)

 - Employee assistance program
